description.en: MiniMax Music 3 text-to-music generation with lyrics conditioning.
description.zh: MiniMax Music 3 文本生音乐，支持歌词条件。

lyrics.en: Lyrics to sing. Structure tags such as [verse] and [chorus] are supported.
lyrics.zh: 要演唱的歌词。支持 [verse]、[chorus] 等结构标签。

duration_sec.en: Positive AR frame budget expressed in seconds; not a hard final waveform duration limit.
duration_sec.zh: 正 AR 帧预算（以秒为单位）；不是硬性的最终波形持续时间限制。

num_inference_steps.en: Flow matching Euler steps per chunk.
num_inference_steps.zh: 每个分块的流匹配 Euler 步数。

guidance_scale.en: Flow transformer classifier-free guidance scale. Must be > 0.
guidance_scale.zh: 流量变压器无分级机指导秤。必须 > 0。

ar_guidance_scale.en: Autoregressive semantic and depth CFG scale. Must be > 0.
ar_guidance_scale.zh: 自回归语义和深度 CFG 量表。必须 > 0。

top_k.en: Top-k sampling for semantic and residual code sampling.
top_k.zh: 语义与残差码采样所用的 top-k。

ensemble_takes.en: Independent takes in a batched AR pass using consecutive seeds; flow/vocoder decode each take. Named outputs take_01 through take_NN are emitted only when ensemble_takes > 1; otherwise only primary audio is returned.
ensemble_takes.zh: 使用连续种子独立接收批量 AR 通道；流/声码器解码每个镜头。仅当 ensemble_takes > 1 时才会发出命名输出 take_01 到 take_NN；否则仅返回主音频。

ensemble_prefix_frames.en: Shared intro frames before ensemble takes fork, approximately 25 frames per second. Zero disables intro locking.
ensemble_prefix_frames.zh: 在 ensemble 分叉之前共享介绍帧，大约每秒 25 帧。零禁用介绍锁定。

flow_chunk_hop_frames.en: Flow chunk hop in AR frames, approximately 25 per second. Zero uses checkpoint configuration; positive values are capped at the configured chunk size.
flow_chunk_hop_frames.zh: AR 帧中的流块跳跃，大约每秒 25 次。零使用检查点配置；正值的上限为配置的块大小。

flow_uncond_interval.en: Evaluate unconditional flow CFG every N-th step, reusing the guidance delta between evaluations. Values <= 1 disable reuse and evaluate both branches every step.
flow_uncond_interval.zh: 每 N 步评估一次无条件 flow CFG，并在两次评估间复用引导差值；<=1 关闭复用，每步评估两个分支。

flow_uncond_warmup.en: Initial flow steps that evaluate both CFG branches before guidance-delta reuse; nonpositive values add no warmup.
flow_uncond_warmup.zh: 复用引导差值前的初始 flow 步数，期间评估两个 CFG 分支；非正值不预热。
